references.text: God commands Moses to take off his sandals because the place where he stands is holy ground—exactly the same command given to Joshua
The burning bush where God reveals himself to Moses, and the place is declared holy
Stephen quotes the command to remove sandals on holy ground in his speech about Moses
God's command concerning holiness because the Lord is holy—the same theme of a holy place and God's presence
Seraphim in God's holy presence—the theme of holiness in God's presence
